label: Current density
subgoals: Convert square micrometres to square centimetres
Divide current by area for the density

label: Black's equation
subgoals: Take the ratio of the two current densities
Raise it to the current exponent
Scale the known lifetime by the result

label: Allowed current for a lifetime
subgoals: Take the ratio of the lifetimes
Raise it to one over the current exponent
Multiply the known density by the factor
